summary: INTRO Control Centre Phase 1 tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/26 pytest cases pass (96%). Frontend: login → dashboard (KPIs, 6 SVG charts, System Status chips, DEMO badge), LIVE/DEMO switch with confirm modal, sidebar navigation to all Phase 1 pages, Users list + search + detail (profile, counts, timeline, admin action buttons), Professional Verification queue tabs, Command Centre with category+time filters, Admin Users (Create admin form with roles + list showing both super admins), Audit Logs with all our test actions logged (admin_email, mode, old/new values, IP), Payments placeholder correctly shows 'Payment integration not configured'. Global search from topbar works ('sana' → dropdown result). Bootstrap admin (k97davies) correctly returns must_change_password=true and gated dashboard (403). Wrong-password returns 401 with generic 'Invalid credentials'. Reauth+ban+audit flow verified via API. One minor spec deviation found: HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS includes 'suspend' — the spec says only ban+delete need reauth for users (suspend is correctly high-risk only for the reports module).

minor.issue: Suspend on a user returns HTTP 428 requiring reauth. Per spec, only 'ban' and 'delete' should need reauth for users; 'suspend' should succeed without prior reauth. Root cause: control_center.py:45 defines HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS = {'ban','delete','suspend'} globally, then user action handler runs _check_recent_reauth() for any action in that set. Recommended: remove 'suspend' from HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS and instead gate suspend per-module (only inside the reports action handler, as is already done for ban).

issues: No testID/data-testid on any control-centre interactive element (email/password inputs, Sign in button, DEMO/LIVE badge, modal Confirm/Cancel, sidebar links, user-row, Admin Action buttons). Everything currently has to be selected by text — brittle for future testing. Recommend adding testIDs (login-email, login-password, login-submit, mode-badge, mode-switch-confirm, sidebar-{route}, user-row-{id}, admin-action-{key}, reauth-password, reauth-submit).

Placeholder pages (Payments, Feature Flags, etc.) show wording like 'Payments arrives in Phase 3' — the review request expected wording 'Coming Soon'. The intent (a placeholder + Phase note + payment-integration-not-configured message) is satisfied, but you may want the copy to include the literal 'Coming Soon' string too.

rca_of_issue: Suspend-requires-reauth bug: control_center.py line 45 declares HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS = {'ban','delete','suspend'}. In control_user_action (line 545) any action in that set triggers _check_recent_reauth(), so a plain suspend now returns 428 unless the admin reauthed in the last 5 minutes. Per the review-request spec ('admin actions: suspend/unsuspend/ban/force logout/verify email/reset password/delete — ban+delete need reauth'), suspend should NOT require reauth on users. Mitigation: drop 'suspend' from HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS. The reports module already independently calls _check_recent_reauth() for its suspend/ban actions (lines 749-756), so removing 'suspend' from the global set does not weaken report-suspend gating.
